head: Mistake 1: The weekend reset
l: Clean Mon to Fri, 4,000 calories Sat and Sun
r: Max one untracked meal all weekend

items.head: Same weights for months
items.sub: Lifts flat for 4 weeks? Add a rep or 2.5kg.

items.head: Starving all day, bingeing at night

label: MISTAKE 4
head: A 6-day plan you quit by week 3
sub: 45 to 60 minutes, built around your job.

items.head: Waiting to feel motivated
items.sub: Same meals, same training days, fewer decisions.

items.head: Sitting 23 hours a day
items.sub: 8 to 10k steps. Walk 10 minutes after meals.

items.head: Dieting without lifting
items.sub: No muscle and you just become a smaller soft guy.

items.head: A new plan every 2 weeks
items.sub: Run one for 8 to 12 weeks. Watch the weekly average.

text: You don't have a discipline problem. You have a *structure* problem.
